lines.en: label christmas6:
scene secretsanta5
I walk into the room with Chika (Who immediately ducks into the bathroom to fix her makeup) and find that the rest of the girls have already started handing out presents.
lines.zh: 我和 Chika 走进房间（她立刻钻进浴室去补妆），发现其他女孩已经开始发礼物了。

lines.en: I’m assuming there’s no way I’m actually exempt from giving someone a gift, so I guess this is the moment of truth where I just wait around to see who I disappoint.
lines.zh: 我猜我是绝对免不了要给谁送礼物的，所以我想，这就是那个「真相时刻」——我就在这儿等着看自己会让谁失望。

lines.en: Unless I actually {i}do{/i} wind up with Chika.
lines.zh: 除非我最后{i}真的{/i}抽到了 Chika。

lines.en: In that case, I’ll just use her first semi-public orgasm as my Secret Santa present.
lines.zh: 那样的话，我就把她第一次半公开的性高潮当作我的神秘圣诞老人礼物好了。

lines.en: Which would be kind of awesome because I didn’t even have to giftwrap it.
lines.zh: 那还挺棒的，因为我连包装都不用。

lines.en: : What is with that face?
lines.zh: : 你那是什么表情？

lines.en: : What face? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么表情？你在说什么？

lines.en: : You have a disgusting expression that makes it look like you’re reflecting on something gross you’ve probably done.
lines.zh: : 你脸上那副恶心的样子，看起来像是正在回味某件你大概干过的恶心事。

lines.en: : I think...you look the same as always...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你看起来跟平时一样啊……Sensei……

lines.en: : Yes, I agree.
lines.zh: : 对，我同意。

lines.en: : You always look like you’re caught in the middle of thinking something horrible.
lines.zh: : 你看起来永远都像是正在想着什么可怕的事情时被抓了个正着。

lines.en: : That...isn’t what I said.
lines.zh: : 我……不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Thank you for being so pure, Sana.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你这么纯洁，Sana。

lines.en: : And thank you Maya for...
lines.zh: : 还有谢谢你 Maya，谢谢你……

lines.en: : For what?
lines.zh: : 谢什么？

lines.en: : For always wearing clothes that accentuate your legs.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你总是穿能衬托你腿的衣服。

lines.en: : You had me for Secret Santa, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你抽到的是我吧，神秘圣诞老人？

lines.en: scene secretsanta2
: I’d have given you something much different if that were true.
lines.zh: : 要是那样的话，我给你的东西会大不一样。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? And what would-
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？那会是——

lines.en: : Anthrax.
lines.zh: : 炭疽。

lines.en: : ...Okay, so moving right along then. Shouldn’t you two be giving your gifts out instead of just standing around?
lines.zh: : ……好吧，那就先不提这个了。你们两个不是该去发礼物吗，怎么还站着？

lines.en: : Who did you have?
lines.zh: : 你们抽到的是谁？

lines.en: scene secretsanta3
: I...had Chika but...she kind of disappeared into the bathroom so now I have to keep standing here awkwardly.
lines.zh: : 我……抽到了 Chika，不过……她不知跑哪儿去了，进了浴室，所以我现在只能尴尬地站在这儿。

lines.en: Shit. Looks like I {i}will{/i} be disappointing someone after all.
lines.zh: 操。看来我{i}终究{/i}还是会让某个人失望了。

lines.en: : What did you get her?
lines.zh: : 你给她买了什么？

lines.en: scene secretsanta4
: Well...I don’t really know her well so I...wound up just buying her some...girly stuff I found from the mall.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不太了解她，所以……最后就买了些……在商场找到的女孩子用的东西。

lines.en: : Rin helped me, but she kept trying to make me go over the spending limit.
lines.zh: : Rin 帮了我，可她一直想让我超预算。

lines.en: : She even offered using her own money, but...that just felt strange...
lines.zh: : 她甚至提出用她自己的钱，不过……那感觉太奇怪了……

lines.en: : Yeah that sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 是啊，听起来就是她会干的事。

lines.en: : If there’s anyone who knows what Chika would like, it’s Rin.
lines.zh: : 要说谁最懂 Chika 会喜欢什么，那肯定是 Rin。

lines.en: : R-Really? Not Yumi?
lines.zh: : 真、真的吗？不是 Yumi 吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Definitely Rin.
lines.zh: : 不是。绝对是 Rin。

lines.en: scene secretsanta5
: I didn’t realize they were that close...
lines.zh: : 我都不知道她们那么亲近……

lines.en: : Sometimes I don’t think they’re close enough.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得她们还不够亲近。

lines.en: : I...don’t know what that means.
lines.zh: : 我……不明白那是什么意思。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’ll tell you when you’re older.
lines.zh: : 别担心。等你长大点我再告诉你。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : And Maya? What about you?
lines.zh: : 还有 Maya？你呢？

lines.en: : Who’s the lucky recipient of whatever strange gift you decided to purchase?
lines.zh: : 你那份奇怪礼物的幸运收件人是谁？

lines.en: : Futaba. Also MIA.
lines.zh: : Futaba。也是失踪人口。

lines.en: : I think she went to get some water. Seeing everyone kiss seemed to really take a toll on her.
lines.zh: : 我想她是去倒水了。看大家接吻似乎真的让她受不了。

lines.en: : Wait, don’t tell me that kept going after I left the room?
lines.zh: : 等等，别告诉我我离开房间后那事还在继续？

lines.en: scene secretsanta6
: You missed out on an entire orgy. Poor Sana nearly had to go to the hospital.
lines.zh: : 你错过了一整场群交。可怜的 Sana 差点要送医院。

lines.en: : Wha-?!
: Th-th-th-th-that never happened!
lines.zh: : 那、那、那、那根本没发生过！

lines.en: : I’ve still never...k...k...
lines.zh: : 我到现在都还没……亲……亲……

lines.en: : Good. Stay that way forever.
lines.zh: : 很好。永远保持下去。

lines.en: scene secretsanta7
: For...ever?...
: Joking aside. All of the debauchery managed to miraculously end the second you left the room.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。你一离开房间，所有的放荡就奇迹般地结束了。

lines.en: : I wonder how that happened?
lines.zh: : 我在想，这是怎么回事呢？

lines.en: Pretty sure Chika just brought all of it outside.
lines.zh: 我敢说 Chika 是把这一切都带到室外去了。

lines.en: And that, I am thankful for.
lines.zh: 而对此，我心怀感激。

lines.en: : So...I guess since you two are the only ones standing around, it means one of you is the person I have to disappoint?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然只有你们两个在这儿干站着，那是不是说明，我要让你们其中一个失望了？

lines.en: : Oh, you had me. I’ve known the whole time.
lines.zh: : 哦，你抽到的是我。我从头到尾都知道。

lines.en: : But I’m used to you disappointing me, so it’s fine that you didn’t get me anything.
lines.zh: : 不过我已经习惯被你失望了，所以你没给我准备东西也没关系。

lines.en: scene secretsanta8
: Wait, you knew this whole time and you didn’t tell me?
lines.zh: : 等等，你一直都知道却没告诉我？

lines.en: : I specifically asked {i}you{/i} earlier because I figured you’d know.
lines.zh: : 我之前特意问了{i}你{/i}，就是觉得你会知道。

lines.en: : Are you saying you lied to me back then?
lines.zh: : 你是说你那时候骗了我？

lines.en: : I lie to you literally all the time. I don’t think this should come as that big of a surprise.
lines.zh: : 我对你撒谎简直是家常便饭。我觉得这不该让你那么意外。

lines.en: : Why, though? Don’t you want a present?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？你不想要礼物吗？

lines.en: scene secretsanta9
: Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太想。

lines.en: : But if this is about not looking like a complete jerk, you can just tell everyone that this scarf was an early Secret Santa present.
lines.zh: : 不过如果这是为了让你看起来不那么像个彻头彻尾的混蛋，你可以跟大家说，这条围巾是提前送的神秘圣诞老人礼物。

lines.en: : But then again, I don’t think you care much about not looking like a jerk, so you can just disregard that.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我觉得你也不太在乎自己看起来像不像个混蛋，所以你可以当我没说。

lines.en: : I really want to feel bad about myself for letting you down right now but being insulted is making that a little more difficult.
lines.zh: : 我现在真的很想为自己让你失望而内疚，可一直被你骂，让这件事难了不少。

lines.en: scene secretsanta8
: It’s fine. You hate Christmas anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正你讨厌圣诞节。

lines.en: : Use my present money to get something for Ami or Ayane. You know- people who would actually like to receive presents from you.
lines.zh: : 用给我买礼物的钱给 Ami 或者 Ayane 买点什么吧。你知道的——那些真的会乐意收到你礼物的人。

lines.en: : You liked the scarf so much that you literally collapsed.
lines.zh: : 你喜欢那条围巾喜欢到直接瘫倒了。

lines.en: : That never happened.
lines.zh: : 那从没发生过。

lines.en: : I graciously accepted this accessory and politely bowed before walking away.
lines.zh: : 我优雅地收下了这件配饰，礼貌地鞠了一躬，然后走开了。

lines.en: : The reset must have destroyed your memory.
lines.zh: : 肯定是重置把你的记忆弄坏了。

lines.en: : R...Reset?
lines.zh: : 重……重置？

lines.en: scene secretsanta9
: It’s a long story.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: Did she really just summarize the fact that we’ve literally reset the[school] year together {i}twice{/i} with “It’s a long story?”
lines.zh: 她真的就用一句「说来话长」，概括了我们真的把[school]学年一起重置过{i}两次{/i}这件事吗？

lines.en: I mean, she’s not wrong but...
lines.zh: 我是说，她也没说错，不过……

lines.en: That seems kind of anti-climactic.
lines.zh: 这也太轻描淡写了。

lines.en: : There’s really nothing I can do to make it up to you?
lines.zh: : 真的没有我能做的来弥补你吗？

lines.en: scene secretsanta10
: To make it up to me? Hmm...
lines.zh: : 弥补我？嗯……

lines.en: scene secretsanta11
: Could you leave me alone forever?
lines.zh: : 你能永远别来烦我吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : Didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : Then no.
lines.zh: : 那就没有。

lines.en: : The best thing you could do right now, though, is stop drawing attention to the fact that the two of us are talking to one another.
lines.zh: : 不过你现在能做的最好的事，就是别再张扬我们两个在说话这件事。

lines.en: : You’re an annoyingly popular character, so it will be quite troublesome if people begin to think I’m somehow close to you.
lines.zh: : 你是个烦人地受欢迎的角色，所以要是别人开始觉得我和你关系不错，会相当麻烦。

lines.en: : Okay, but eventually I’m going to-
lines.zh: : 好吧，不过我迟早还是要——

lines.en: : Umm...
I feel a suspiciously light tapping on my shoulder after hearing Yumi interject.
lines.zh: 听到 Yumi 插话之后，我感觉到有人可疑地轻轻拍了拍我的肩膀。

lines.en: And I say “suspiciously light” because I assume she is the one tapping me and I associate nothing but pent-up aggression with that girl.
lines.zh: 我说「可疑地轻」，是因为我以为是她在拍我，而我对那个女孩的印象只有压抑着的攻击性。

lines.en: : This is the part where you turn around.
lines.zh: : 现在是转身的那一段。

lines.en: scene secretsanta12
I turn around to find a rather timid version of the class delinquent hiding half of her face behind a brightly colored notebook.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到一个相当怯生生的版本的问题少女，把半张脸藏在一个色彩鲜艳的笔记本后面。

lines.en: And judging by the fact that this particular notebook has “Not a gift” written on it in black permanent marker, I think it’s safe to assume that it is, actually, a gift.
lines.zh: 而从这本笔记本上用黑色记号笔写着「不是礼物」来看，我觉得可以安全地断定：它其实就是礼物。

lines.en: : Yo.
: Is that for me?
lines.zh: : 那是给我的吗？

lines.en: scene secretsanta13
: Not because I want it to be.
lines.zh: : 可不是因为我想给你。

lines.en: : I was just the last person to draw a name out of the stupid fucking hat and everyone probably threw your name back in because you suck so much.
lines.zh: : 我只是最后一个从那该死的帽子里抽名字的人，而且大家大概都把你的名字扔回去了，因为你实在太讨厌了。

lines.en: : But you still got me something anyway?
lines.zh: : 可你还是给我准备了东西？

lines.en: : I figured you would have just skipped something like this.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你会直接跳过这种事。

lines.en: scene secretsanta14
: I wanted to but...Chika and Chinami found out and made me do this.
lines.zh: : 我是想跳过来着，不过……Chika 和 Chinami 发现了，逼我做的。

lines.en: : It’s not like I bought anything or whatever, though. I just kind of...wrote you a note. I guess.
lines.zh: : 不过我也没买什么东西什么的。我只是……给你写了张纸条。大概是吧。

lines.en: : Well, can I read it?
lines.zh: : 那么，我能看看吗？

lines.en: scene secretsanta15
: No. Fuck off.
lines.zh: : 不行。滚开。

lines.en: : So you wrote me a note that I’m not allowed to read and that is my Christmas present?
lines.zh: : 所以你给我写了张不许我看的纸条，那就是我的圣诞礼物？

lines.en: : You can read it just...
lines.zh: : 你可以看，只是……

lines.en: : My body won’t let me hand it over to you.
lines.zh: : 我的身体不让我把它交给你。

lines.en: : Probably because it’s looking out for me and knows it will be a bad move if I show you anything that could even be confused for affection.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为它在保护我，知道我要是给你看任何可能被误认成好感的东西，都会是个坏决定。

lines.en: : Give me the hate letter, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 把那封仇恨信给我，Yumi。

lines.en: scene secretsanta16
: I-It’s not a hate letter!
lines.zh: : 那、那不是仇恨信！

lines.en: : It was going to be but the fuckin...Chosokabes kept makin’ me rewrite it until they approved it!
lines.zh: : 本来是的，可那对姓长宗我部的非要我一直重写，直到她们点头为止！

lines.en: : So this is the fifth letter! Or sixth! I don’t even remember!
lines.zh: : 所以这是第五封！还是第六封！我都记不清了！

lines.en: scene secretsanta17
: AAAAAHHH JUST FUCKING TAKE IT!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊你就他妈拿去吧！

lines.en: Yumi gives up on hiding and literally throws the notebook at my chest.
lines.zh: Yumi 放弃了躲藏，直接把笔记本朝我胸口扔了过来。

lines.en: I catch it with my impressively great reflexes and immediately retreat to the door to see what she could have possibly written about me.
lines.zh: 我以惊人的反应速度接住了它，立刻退到门口，想看看她到底写了些什么关于我的东西。

lines.en: scene black
scene secretsanta18
This is actually weirdly touching.
lines.zh: 这其实意外地感人。

lines.en: Maybe it’s just the obnoxiously happy background music or the fact that she was so embarrassed about handing this over but...
lines.zh: 也许只是因为背景音乐吵闹得过分欢快，或者是因为她递出这东西时那么害羞，不过……

lines.en: I actually like this present a lot.
lines.zh: 我真的很喜欢这份礼物。

lines.en: It’s the perfect thing for someone like me who hates the holidays and can’t find a point for most material goods.
lines.zh: 对一个讨厌节日、又找不到大多数物质商品意义的人来说，这再合适不过了。

lines.en: Sometimes, it’s good to just...hear what someone has to say from the heart.
lines.zh: 有时候，就这样……听听某人发自内心想说的话，是件好事。

lines.en: And sure this might be a little more exaggerated or kind than how Yumi really feels-
lines.zh: 当然，这也许比 Yumi 真实的感觉要夸张一点、或者善良一点——

lines.en: But the fact that she was able to write something like this down after what I did to her is really...
lines.zh: 但在我对她做了那些事之后，她还能写下这样的东西，这真的很……

lines.en: Rewarding?
lines.zh: 有回报？

lines.en: Surprising, maybe?
lines.zh: 或者说是惊喜？

lines.en: Oh no. This isn’t one of those Christmas miracles, is it?
lines.zh: 哦不。这该不会就是那种圣诞奇迹吧？

lines.en: scene secretsanta19
: Make fun of me and I’ll fucking kill you. Got it?
lines.zh: : 你要是敢取笑我，我就杀了你。明白吗？

lines.en: : Thanks, Yumi. I really appreciate this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Yumi。我真的很感激。

lines.en: : You appreciate me calling you “Not the worst ever?”
lines.zh: : 你感激我写你「还不算最烂的」？

lines.en: : You know, I really do.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真的感激。

lines.en: : Oh. Well...cool, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦。那……挺好，大概吧。

lines.en: : Can you give me the notebook back now?
lines.zh: : 你能把笔记本还给我了吗？

lines.en: : Wait, you need it back?
lines.zh: : 等等，你要拿回去？

lines.en: : That’s the only notebook I own and I need it for[school].
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一一本笔记本，我[school]要用。

lines.en: : You don’t even come to[school].
lines.zh: : 你根本不来[school]。

lines.en: : And I wouldn’t give you any notes to take even if you did.
lines.zh: : 就算你来，我也不会让你记任何笔记。

lines.en: scene secretsanta20
: J-Just give it back, okay?! It’s embarrassing for you to hang on to it!
lines.zh: : 你、你还给我就行了？！你拿着它让我很丢脸！

lines.en: : I don’t want you fucking...jerking off on it or something.
lines.zh: : 我可不想你他妈……对着它打飞机什么的。

lines.en: : I can’t believe I have to say this but I’m not going to jerk off on your Christmas present.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信自己得说这种话，但我不会对着你的圣诞礼物打飞机。

lines.en: : Like I’d fuckin’ believe that! Give it back, asshole!
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不信！还给我，混蛋！

lines.en: scene black
Yumi moves toward me to try and grab the notebook forcefully, causing me to backpedal and make my way toward the door with a death grip on it.
lines.zh: Yumi 朝我扑过来想硬抢笔记本，逼得我连连后退，死死攥着它往门口挪。

lines.en: This may seem like just a silly note to some, but for me- it is a symbol of progress.
lines.zh: 对某些人来说这也许只是一张蠢纸条，但对我来说——它是进步的象征。

lines.en: A trophy that I must treasure.
lines.zh: 一件我必须珍藏的战利品。

lines.en: I shall protect it in any way I can.
lines.zh: 我会不惜一切保护它。

lines.en: : Huh? What’s going on out here?
lines.zh: : 嗯？外面在闹什么？

lines.en: : FUCKING...STOP...RUNNING!
lines.zh: : 你他妈……别……跑！

lines.en: scene secretsanta21
: I go into the bathroom for five minutes and that’s all it takes for you to explode? What happened?
lines.zh: : 我就进浴室五分钟，这就够你炸毛了？出什么事了？

lines.en: : Chika! Tell him to give me back my notebook!
lines.zh: : Chika！叫他把笔记本还给我！

lines.en: : Your notebook?
lines.zh: : 你的笔记本？

lines.en: : Is this because of the Secret Santa thing?
lines.zh: : 是因为神秘圣诞老人那事吗？

lines.en: : Yes! Tell him he has to give it back!
lines.zh: : 对！跟他说他必须还给我！

lines.en: : But...he doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 可是……他不用还啊。

lines.en: : Do you not understand how presents work?
lines.zh: : 你不懂礼物是怎么运作的吗？

lines.en: scene secretsanta22
: He...gets to keep that?!
lines.zh: : 他……可以留着那玩意儿？！

lines.en: : Of course~
lines.zh: : 当然啦～

lines.en: : Besides, doesn’t it make you happy knowing he can pull it out and look at it whenever he wants?
lines.zh: : 再说，知道他能随时掏出来看看，你难道不开心吗？

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhh, no?!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃，不？！

lines.en: : If he keeps that then...where am I going to write all of my notes for[school]?!
lines.zh: : 要是他留着，那我[school]的笔记要写在哪儿啊？！

lines.en: : You don’t even come to[school].
lines.zh: : 你根本不来[school]啊。

lines.en: : And Sensei wouldn’t give you any notes to take even if you did.
lines.zh: : 就算你来，Sensei 也不会让你记任何笔记。

lines.en: : See? That’s exactly what I said.
lines.zh: : 看吧？我就是这么说的。

lines.en: scene secretsanta23
: Stay the fuck out of this. This doesn’t concern you.
lines.zh: : 你他妈别插嘴。这跟你没关系。

lines.en: : This is literally {i}about{/i} me...
lines.zh: : 这{i}就是{/i}关于我的事啊……

lines.en: scene black
Yumi and Chika proceed to argue about how imperative it is that Yumi gets her notebook back.
lines.zh: Yumi 和 Chika 接着为「Yumi 必须拿回笔记本」这件事有多要紧而吵了起来。

lines.en: We offer the compromise for me to just remove the page with the note on it but, of course, this was never about not being able to take notes for[school].
lines.zh: 我们提出折中方案，让我把写着纸条的那页撕下来就行，不过，当然，这从来就不是能不能记[school]笔记的问题。

lines.en: I don’t know if Yumi’s afraid of looking weak or if she just thinks I’m going to...use this against her in some way-
lines.zh: 我不知道 Yumi 是怕显得软弱，还是觉得我会……拿这个来对付她——

lines.en: But I really do just want to keep it and tuck it away in some drawer to forget about and probably look back on for nostalgic value many years from now.
lines.zh: 可我真的只是想留着它，塞进某个抽屉里忘掉，然后很多年以后大概会出于怀旧再翻出来看看。

lines.en: If I even make it to “many years from now.”
lines.zh: 如果我能活到「很多年以后」的话。

lines.en: But hey, months ago, I never would have even dreamed of getting an acknowledgement of how I’m not literally Satan from Yumi.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，几个月前，我连梦到 Yumi 承认我不完全是撒旦都不敢想。

lines.en: So if this can happen, literally anything can happen.
lines.zh: 所以既然这种事都能发生，那真的什么都有可能发生。

lines.en: A loud bang can be heard from outside as the walls of the hotel are dyed with bright, red light.
lines.zh: 外面传来一声巨响，酒店的墙壁被明亮的红色光芒染透。

lines.en: In addition to Christmas lights and decorations, it seems like fireworks are a thing I’m apparently going to have to deal with now as well.
lines.zh: 除了圣诞灯饰和装饰之外，看来烟花也成了我现在不得不应付的东西之一。

lines.en: One by one, girls begin leaving the room and heading outside, grabbing my sleeves and trying to get me to come with them.
lines.zh: 女孩们一个接一个地离开房间往外面走，抓住我的袖子想拉我一起去。

lines.en: There are two exceptions to this.
lines.zh: 有两个例外。

lines.en: Well, I guess three technically.
lines.zh: 嗯，严格算是三个。

lines.en: The first two come in the form of Makoto and Miku, who leave the room in a hurry- likely to get Miku somewhere she won’t be able to hear anything.
lines.zh: 前两个是 Makoto 和 Miku，她们匆匆离开房间——大概是要把 Miku 带到听不见声音的地方。

lines.en: I think about following them, but realize Makoto is probably better suited to dealing with Miku’s condition than I’ll ever be.
lines.zh: 我想过跟上去，不过意识到 Makoto 大概永远比我更适合应付 Miku 的状况。

lines.en: Instead, I remain in the room with the second exception to the sudden and intense interest in fireworks.
lines.zh: 相反，我留在了房间里，陪着第二个对烟花突然高涨的兴趣无动于衷的例外。
